audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits a 49.94% WR lane where his 750-1050 range dictates early and her two-item gap-close flips late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart was blanket 'Skill' on rows 0-5 and 'Xerath' on row 6, while content and packet both say Xerath 0-5 / Taliyah at 2+ items — full row 6 was flat backwards vs both.
audit.why: Kits agree with content: artillery range owns early, total immobility loses to W-E/Wall-flank once she has items.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned: Xerath rows 0-5, Taliyah row 6; every moved row's why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated name 'Rite of the Ancients' (really Rite of the Arcane) in whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid. Missing interaction never stated: his R is a self-immobilizing channel that any Taliyah CC cancels. Content implied Taliyah's W-E is a dash ('stun your dash', 'your W-E dash') — it is not; she has no dash outside R surf.
audit.why: Kit file is authority on names; missingInteractions lists the channel-cancel; Taliyah kit has no dash flag on W/E.
audit.corrected: Name fixed in all three fields; channel-cancel added to report[5] and breakdown.cooldowns; dash phrasing corrected in spikes[0], early, wants.foe[1].
Shocking Orb 13s rank 1, W 14s now stated.

edits.before: Xerath out-ranges you at every level of lane: Arcanopulse and Eye of Destruction poke you off the wave before you can trade back, and Shocking Orb stuns any dash you try. edits.after: Xerath out-ranges you at every level of lane: Arcanopulse and Eye of Destruction poke you off the wave before you can trade back, and Shocking Orb stuns you the moment you step up. Farm from max range, use Rock Surfing to weave between his skillshots, and don't force W-E until you've dodged his Q.

edits.before: Xerath simply out-ranges you in lane. Arcanopulse and Eye of Destruction poke you every time you step up to farm, and his Shocking Orb stuns your approach, so the early levels belong to him. Play respectful: use Rock Surfing to dodge between his skillshots, take safe last-hits from max range, and don't throw W-E into a champion who can stun your dash on reaction.
